purpose: Bind the SR-004 anomaly to exact GSI programme identifiers and distinguish target-central data from other SR-004 cruise archive material.

canonical_programme.title: Seabed Mapping, Morphometry, Sediment composition and Sediment transport in the Continental Slope, Off Cochin, Kerala
canonical_programme.source: Minutes of the 52nd Meeting of the Kerala State Geological Programming Board, Marine and Coastal Survey Division, Geological Survey of India, Mangalore

underlying_gsi_report.claim: A later GSI-authored paper cites 'Pillai et al., 2016, Geological Survey of India Report, Unpublished' for the SR-004 survey-area bathymetry/circular depression context.
underlying_gsi_report.source: Bhadra Kumary et al., Glacial-Interglacial Cycles over the Past 150,000 years of South-Eastern Arabian Sea, 2024
underlying_gsi_report.importance: This report is now the highest-value archival target because it may contain station coordinates, cruise maps, MBES/SBP line geometry, sample IDs and full survey metadata omitted from the short Current Science correspondence.

sr004_pc001_archive.critical_firewall: The circular depression floor is approximately 155-160 m water depth. PC-001 is at 635 m water depth. Therefore PC-001 MUST NOT be identified with the 12.5 m core taken from the center of the circular depression.
sr004_pc001_archive.epistemic_effect: Proves that SR-004 produced a richer, long-lived physical core archive and that later GSI Field Season programmes revisited SR-004 material. It does not provide a deeper core beneath the anomaly.

target_central_core.published_result: coarse fraction did not yield minerals indicating shock metamorphism
target_central_core.firewall: Do not merge this core with SR-004/PC-001.

facts: The paper explicitly describes the 600 m diameter, 40 m deep circular depression in the middle of the eastern part of the survey area.
It reports eastern terrain at 100-360 m water depth, western terrain at 360-1650 m, a 95-150 m topographic high, a 1-3 km wide channel and steep gullies on scarp faces.
Its bathymetric interpretation cites the unpublished 2016 GSI report.
2024_gsi_paper.interpretation: Useful for survey-area morphology and archive lineage; not independent high-resolution confirmation of impact origin.

sd267_sd268.description: High resolution mapping of Contiguous Zone beyond territorial waters in Arabian Sea off Kochi, Kerala, Blocks A/B, cited in the same Kerala State Geological Programming Board minutes.
sd267_sd268.firewall: Do not call these repeat surveys of the crater without polygon/track intersection.
